arguments.content:
# Design Document — Small Python Feature (Fixture Variation 2)

## 1. Objective
Implement a small, self-contained Python feature, cover it with unit tests, build the
package, and prepare a simulated code review.

## 2. Proposed Feature
A `TextStats` utility module providing simple, dependency-free text analytics:

- `word_count(text: str) -> int` — number of whitespace-delimited tokens.
- `char_count(text: str, include_spaces: bool = True) -> int` — character count.
- `top_words(text: str, n: int = 3) -> list[tuple[str, int]]` — most frequent
  lowercased words, ties broken alphabetically.

Design notes:
- Pure functions, no I/O, no third-party dependencies.
- Deterministic output to make tests stable.
- Input validation: raise `TypeError` for non-`str` input; raise `ValueError` for `n < 1`.

## 3. Module Layout
```
textstats/
  __init__.py        # exports word_count, char_count, top_words
  stats.py           # implementation
tests/
  test_stats.py      # pytest unit tests
pyproject.toml       # build metadata (setuptools)
```

## 4. Test Plan
| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| word_count basic | "hello world" | 2 |
| word_count empty | "" | 0 |
| word_count whitespace | "  a  b " | 2 |
| char_count with spaces | "ab c" | 4 |
| char_count without spaces | "ab c" | 3 |
| top_words default | "a b a c a b" | [("a",3),("b",2),("c",1)] |
| top_words tie-break | "b a" | [("a",1),("b",1)] |
| type error | 123 | TypeError |
| value error | n=0 | ValueError |

## 5. Build Plan
- `python -m build` producing sdist + wheel.
- Verify install into a clean virtualenv and import `textstats`.

## 6. Simulated Review Checklist
- [ ] Public API documented with docstrings.
- [ ] Edge cases (empty input, whitespace-only, ties) covered by tests.
- [ ] No mutable default arguments.
- [ ] Type hints on all public functions.
- [ ] No external dependencies introduced.
- [ ] Version pinned in `pyproject.toml`.

## 7. Evidence Status
This document is a plan only. No code has been written, no tests executed, and no
build performed, because the current workflow state exposes only the
`design_document` tool. All items above are unverified.
